name: takku
description: Your meetings recorded with Takku in Codex: search what was said, read a note with its transcript, prepare the next meeting, import audio and videos and write Templates.

interface.shortDescription: Search your Takku meetings, import recordings and write Templates
interface.longDescription: Takku records meetings on your Mac, transcribes them locally and writes a Markdown note for each. This plugin lets Codex list those meetings by date, title or participant, search what was said in the summaries, notes and transcripts, read a meeting in full and prepare the next one, through the read-only MCP server built into Takku (Takku does not need to be running). Its skills also import audio and video files, YouTube included with yt-dlp, through the takku command (Takku 1.18.0 or later), and help write and tune Templates. Requires Takku in /Applications.
